en.content: Among the following compounds, the increasing order of their basic strength is :

options.content: (I) < (II) < (IV) < (III)
(I) < (II) < (III) < (IV)
(II) < (I) < (IV) < (III)
(II) < (I) < (III) < (IV)

en.explanation:
The basicity of an amine depends on the ability of its nitrogen atom to donate lone pair of electrons in an acid-base reaction. Resonance, inductive effect and steric hindrance etc. plays a very important role in deciding the basicity of compound.

Among the given compounds, (III) is most basic due to the presence of electron donating methyl group which increases the electron density on nitrogen. Compound (IV) is less basic than (III). Hybridisation of nitrogen atom in aniline (I) and pyrrole (II) is sp3 and sp2 , respectively, therefore, (I) is more basic than (II). Thus, the correct order of basicity is

options.content: (II)
(III)
(IV)

en.explanation: 2-Cyclopropen-1-one cation is a cyclic -system with two electrons. It has highest dipole moment which can be explained on the basis that the dipolar resonance structure contributes more to the resonance hybrid as it involves stable aromatic cyclopropenyl cation.
